4875-6927-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
4875-6927-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Conspiracy, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Damage Control Crew token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-6972-7841.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Darksteel Angel
When Darksteel Angel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Repeat.

2946-4871-5670-6794.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
2946-4871-5670-6794.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-5670-6794.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Susurian Voidborn and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1531-1981-2415-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling the targeted player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

628-2511--5.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5231-7918.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

2728-5147-5662-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2728-5147-5662-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2728-5147-5662-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-3921-7737.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Winding Constrictor
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

676-1849-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
676-1849-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Magnus the Red, triggering Breath of Fury and Magnus the Red.
Resolve the Magnus the Red trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1879-2590-5776-7313.description:
Activate another creature you control, which is a Food due to Ygra, by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Ygra and Experimental Confectioner trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Experimental Confectioner trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Repeat.

413-628-7218.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Reaping Willow.
When Reaping Willow dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Reaping Willow enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

2113-3096-3832.description:
Activate Puresight Merrow by tapping it, adding {W/U}.
Activate Puresight Merrow by paying {W/U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat until your deck is empty
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to win the game due to drawing from an empty library.

2692-2893-3470-6763.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the basic land enters, Lotus Cobra and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

874-2866-3698-4986.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-2866-3698-4986.description:
Cast Delif's Cone by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scrap Trawler and Delif's Cone enter, Grinding Station triggers twice, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Delif's Cone from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat.

1456-4549-5051-5078.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Traxos, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

431-1270-4365-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1270-4365-6753.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of twelve 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

856-2921-5270.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it and Samwise triggers.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain one life.
Resolve the Samwise trigger, creating a Food token.
Repeat.

6014-6659-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another modified creature.
When the creature dies, Guardian of the Forgotten triggers, manifesting the top card of your library.
When the manifested card enters the battlefield, Gylwain triggers, creating a Role token attached to the manifested creature.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

222-527-4927-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4927-6798.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2043-4050-4772-6671.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Magic Pot that are 1/1 Soldiers.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot tokens, adding {2}.
When the Magic Pot tokens die, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

1170-1770-3389-5954-6664.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Instant or Sorcery that deals damage or causes lifeloss to each opponent

3765-6515--102.description:
Cast Mizzix's Mastery for its overload cost by paying {5}{R}{R}{R}, exiling each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard and casting them without paying their mana costs.
Resolve the copy of Worldfire, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to 1.
Resolve the copy of the instant or sorcery that deals damage or causes lifeloss, causing each opponent to lose at least 1 life or be dealt at least 1 damage.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

2178-3967-5173-6095.easyPrerequisites:
Zul Ashur, Lich Lord does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Zul Ashur.
2178-3967-5173-6095.description:
Activate Zul Ashur by tapping it, targeting Shambling Ghast.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambing Ghast dies, it and Zul Ashur trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Zul Ashur trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

643-1766-3767-3918.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
643-1766-3767-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Thran Dynamo's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

1430-2713-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Mirror Image has a power of at least 2.
1430-2713-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Mirror Image and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Mirror Image from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Mirror Image to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Mirror Image by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

4137-5149-5200.easyPrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Sword of the Paruns.
4137-5149-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Blossom-Clad Werewolf does not have summoning sickness.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Blossom-Clad Werewolf
4137-5149-5200.description:
Activate Blossom-Clad Werewolf by tapping it, adding two mana of any color.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {1}, untapping Blossom-Clad Werewolf.
Repeat.
4137-5149-5200.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1849-3259-3986.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control creatures with total power 6 or greater that can attack this combat.
1849-3259-3986.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Battle Cry Goblin as attackers. If needed, declare more creatures as attackers to ensure that the total power of attacking creatures is 6 or greater.
Battle Cry Goblin triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1845-2645-4657.notablePrerequisites:
Magus of the Candelabra does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five Swamps.
1845-2645-4657.description:
Activate five Swamps by tapping them, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Crypt Ghast triggers five times, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {5} and tapping it, untapping five Swamps.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Staff of Domination.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

1379-1806-2604-3002-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Eternal Scourge is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard due to Rest in Peace.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {1}.
Repeat.

2034-3902-4133.description:
Cast Soul Collector by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Soul Collector enters the battlefield, Halana triggers, causing you to pay {2} to have Soul Collector deal damage equal to its power to itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Soul Collector, adding {C}{C}.
When Soul Collector dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

659-2178-2292.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Krenko.
Krenko does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional Goblin.
659-2178-2292.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least two 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a Goblin token.
The Goblin dies, triggering Krenko, untapping Krenko.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

382-2034-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Basilica Shepherd.
Basilica Shepherd enters the battlefield, creating two 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens.
Emiel triggers twice; choose not to pay both times.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Phyrexian Mites, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1987-3075-3227-5116.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
1987-3075-3227-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus and Scrivener, blinking them.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.

950-2605-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Fatestitcher does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Fatestitcher.
950-2605-4222.description:
Activate Lotus Vale by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Lotus Vale.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat steps with a different color for infinite mana of any color.
